exposure: Combination of twins in cephalic and breech presentation
Various positions of twins in the womb
positions of twins in the womb
outcome: Delta pH (difference in pH between first- and second-born twin)
Delta BE (difference in base excess between first- and second-born twin)
cohort: 1,444 twin births at a university medical center
finding: Vaginal delivery of twins appears safe if experienced staff monitor birth weight discrepancies, birth interval, and blood values, as longer birth intervals were associated with greater delta pH and lower pH in the second twin.
mod_finding: Delta pH values were significantly lower in vaginal deliveries compared to secondary and primary cesarean sections.
